edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the recipient of _safeMint in mintBAI.
msg.sender is the recipient of _safeMint in the owner mint path.
withdraw authorizes the caller via onlyOwner using msg.sender before transferring funds.
mintBAI calls getBAIPrice and multiplies the price by requestedAmount to validate msg.value.
mintBAI compares totalSupply plus requestedAmount against BAI_SUPPLY using SafeMath.add.
mintBAI gates minting on block.number relative to SALE_REVEAL_BLOCK.
mintBAI conditionally writes startingIndexBlock once the sale completes or reveal block passes.
mintBAI sets _mintedBeforeReveal[mintIndex] for tokens minted prior to the reveal block.
mintBAI batch-calls _safeMint(msg.sender) which may invoke onERC721Received on a malicious recipient contract.
mintBAIByOwner bounds totalSupply plus requestedAmount by BAI_SUPPLY using SafeMath.add.
mintBAIByOwner calls _safeMint which can trigger an external onERC721Received callback.
withdraw forwards the entire balance to msg.sender via an external call, transferring execution control.
The constructor sets the inherited _baseURI storage variable.
changeBaseURI writes the new base URI into _baseURI.
setProvenanceHash writes the supplied hash into BAI_PROVENANCE.
isMintedBeforeReveal reads the _mintedBeforeReveal mapping.
finalizeStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock as the blockhash source seed.
finalizeStartingIndex writes the derived startingIndex shuffling value.
finalizeStartingIndex derives randomness from blockhash, which validators/miners can influence.
finalizeStartingIndex takes blockhash modulo BAI_SUPPLY and uses SafeMath.add/sub on the index.
requestedAmount parameter drives the mint count checks and loop in mintBAI.
requestedAmount parameter drives the mint count checks and loop in mintBAIByOwner.
baseURI parameter is written to storage by changeBaseURI.
provenanceHash parameter is written to storage by setProvenanceHash.
index parameter selects the mapping entry returned by isMintedBeforeReveal.
currentBlockNumber local feeds the price tier comparisons in getBAIPrice.
mintIndex local is derived from totalSupply and used for flagging and minting in mintBAI.
balance local holds the contract balance forwarded to msg.sender in withdraw.
mintIndex local is derived from totalSupply and used in the owner mint loop.

normalization_plan.reason: The requestedAmount parameter only exists to size the mint loop and supply checks of mintBAI.
The requestedAmount parameter is only meaningful inside the owner mint loop.
The baseURI parameter is directly consumed and stored by changeBaseURI.
The provenanceHash parameter is directly consumed and stored by setProvenanceHash.
The index parameter is only used to index the _mintedBeforeReveal mapping in isMintedBeforeReveal.
The currentBlockNumber local is a transient cache used only within getBAIPrice's comparisons.
The mintIndex local is derived and consumed exclusively within the mintBAI loop.
The balance local is only the value forwarded by withdraw's external transfer.
The mintIndex local is derived and consumed exclusively within the mintBAIByOwner loop.
